rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"In TypeCollector.GetObjectInfo, a property or field whose key kind does not match the other members is now skipped right after the DoNotMixStringAndIntKeys diagnostic is reported. Members are now added to the intMembers and stringMembers dictionaries only if their key is not already there, so a duplicate key gets the KeysMustBeUnique diagnostic instead of throwing. In MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer.AnalyzeSymbol, the condition for reporting a formatter's inaccessible descriptor is flipped: it now fires only when the formatter is excluded from the source-generated resolver.
